_comment: These are hard numeric limits. Claude's reasoning/thesis step may NEVER override these values. Any proposed trade that violates a rule here must be rejected before it reaches review_equity_order, with no exceptions regardless of how strong the thesis sounds.

stop_loss.note: Every open position must have this stop checked on every cycle, independent of any new thesis about the stock. A good new narrative does not cancel a stop-loss.

execution.note: mode must be manually changed from 'dry_run' to 'live' by the human. Claude must never change this value itself, and must refuse to place live orders while mode is 'dry_run'.

signal_thresholds._comment: A Step-1 candidate qualifies for a Phase A news search + thesis (i.e. counts as a 'notable signal') if it meets ANY ONE of these three, computed from data already pulled in Steps 1-2 (no extra API calls). This is a mechanical gate, not a judgment call. Currently-held positions are exempt and always get a thesis regardless of these thresholds.
